name: nimblescape-typescript
description: The command ts: checks a TypeScript file with tsc and runs it with Node.js, in the terminals of VS Code and with F5 (debug type ts). Gives folders without tsconfig.json the same defaults in the editor, and keeps the auto-import completions to the imports that a program needs.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, VS Code starts no debug session. The command ts works in the terminals, and the editor plugin works where VS Code runs its TypeScript extension.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The TypeScript server of a virtual workspace loads no plugin, and ts needs the files on the disk.

program.description: The TypeScript file that ts checks, compiles and runs. Default: the file of the active editor.

args.description: The arguments of the program: process.argv.slice(2).

cwd.description: The folder in which the program runs. Default: the folder of program.

env.description: Environment variables of the program. null removes a variable.

enumDescriptions: The terminal of VS Code: prompt(), alert() and confirm() can read the keyboard.
The Debug Console: it shows the output but has no keyboard input for the program.
console.description: Where the program runs. Default: the integrated terminal.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first statement of the program, as node --inspect-brk does; in an ES module after its imports.

configurationSnippets.label: TypeScript: Run a file with ts
configurationSnippets.description: Checks, compiles and runs a TypeScript file with the command ts.

nimblescape.typescript.assignmentFolders.markdownDescription: The names of the folders that hold an assignment. An auto-import offers only the files of the assignment root of a file: going up from the file, the first folder with one of these names, or with a `package.json` or `tsconfig.json`; the folder that VS Code has open does not count. An entry of the plugin `nimblescape-typescript-plugin` in `compilerOptions.plugins` of `tsconfig.json` wins over this setting.

nimblescape.typescript.entryFiles.markdownDescription: The names of the files that start a program. When no folder of `#nimblescape.typescript.assignmentFolders#` is found, the first folder above a file that holds one of these files is its assignment root.
